## 0. Statutory NHS Clinical Safety & Epistemic Demarcation (`NHS DCB0129 / DCB0160`)

- **Zero Patient-Identifiable Data (`phi_present = False`):** OpenCareQ ingests and emits strictly aggregate, synthetic, or UK Open Government Licence (`OGL v3.0`) public statistics and experimental `RCSB PDB` coordinates (`CC0 1.0`).
- **Clinician- & Pharmacist-in-Charge Shadow Mode (Non-SaMD):** OpenCareQ is **not a certified medical device**, is **not clinically validated for autonomous patient care**, **never replaces clinician judgment**, has **zero autonomous prescribing approved**, and claims **zero proven physical QPU speedup** today.
- **CSC-QT Non-Scoring & Open Hazard Invariant:** Structured against Oskrochi & Grimes (`BMJ Innovations` 2026, `CC BY 4.0`, https://csc-qt.curistica.com/) with `csc_qt_numerical_score_computed = None` (`35/36` `DCB0129` & `36/36` `DCB0160` structural indicators documented; all `7` clinical hazards `H-OCQ-01`..`H-OCQ-07` remain `OPEN` pending local NHS Trust Clinical Safety Officer `DCB0160` sign-off).
- **ACQ 2D Non-Averaging, Au-Yeung Table 4 HPC-QPU Clock Audit & Gate G4 Classical Floor:** Adheres to Association for Clinical Quantum (`https://clinicalquantum.com/`) standards and Au-Yeung, Camino, Rathore & Kendon (`arXiv:2312.14904v5`, 2025): `2D CQRS (Technical, Clinical)` pairs are never scalar-averaged (`composite_averaged_score = None`), and `Gate G4` hard-blocks noisy QPU dispatch whenever exact `< 65 ms` classical solvers (`SciPy HiGHS MILP`, `RK4`, `Carleman-D2Q9 LBM`, `9q Q-SPH`, `ADAPT-VQE`, `12-Spin Domain-Wall`) suffice on `3 GHz` CPUs, reserving FTQC resource estimation strictly for super-exascale active spaces (`1.0018 ZiB` `#75 6WR1 CYP17A1`, `15.2802 ZiB` `#76 1DNU MPO`, and `233.5786 ZiB` `#82 4OYN Heart H-Ferritin`).
- **Strict `NICE PMG36` `NHS/PSS` Health-Economic Perspective:** All Incremental Net Monetary Benefit (`INMB` at `£20,000/QALY` with Atkinson equity weighting) excludes DWP welfare transfers and employer productivity (`dwp_productivity_transfers_included_in_inmb = False`); preserved workforce/remission/home days are tracked strictly as non-monetised societal co-benefits.

### Public Gate-Free Python DSL & Multi-Backend Architecture

```python
import opencareq as ocq

# 1. Zero-PID UKCore FHIR R4 ingestion + non-Markovian hepatocyte depot memory
pathway = ocq.CarePathway.from_ukcore_fhir(ocq.sample_ukcore_polypharmacy_bundle())
bath    = ocq.DepotBathMemory(cyp3a4_hepatocyte_depot=True, core20_fuel_poverty=True)

# 2. Clinician-in-charge World Model + <1 ms DCB0129 runtime safety guard
wm = ocq.ClinicalWorldModel(memory=bath, safety_guard=ocq.DCB0129Guard())
rollout = wm.counterfactual_select(
    pathway,
    candidates=["welfare->day10_depot_hold_smr->rehab", "rehab->day7_naive_post_washout_restart"],
)

# 3. Evaluate v4.1 Heart Failure (NG106/STRONG-HF/IRONMAN/TA913), Valve Shear & Table 4 HPC-QPU safety
v41_report = wm.evaluate_quantum_heart_failure_continuum(
    nt_probnp_ng_l=2650.0,
    lvef_pct=34.0,
    proposed_iron_route="iv_ferric_derisomaltose",
    qpu_dispatch_for_small_cfd_or_12q_ising=False,
)

# 4. Compile admissible quantum kernels to Quantinuum Guppy 1.0 -> HUGR, NVIDIA CUDA-Q, or Haiqu
hugr_ir = ocq.compile_ir(rollout, target="guppy_hugr")
```
